create_mask_from_index: create a Mask from a single index using Mask.from_index to represent a specific user bit
create_mask_from_indices: create a Mask from a list of indices using Mask.from_indices to represent multiple users at once
create_mask_all_except_index: create a Mask for all indices except one using Mask.all_except_index to exclude a single user
create_users_with_activation: create a Users instance with a max user count and optionally activate all users on initialization
iterate_active_user_indices: iterate over active user indices using Users.indices with a Mask to yield matching user positions
